issues: pnpm provisioned solely via corepack with no 11.x package fallback — if corepack enable fails (network/offline), no pnpm is available
No note flagging that flake.nix's pnpm_10 contradicts package.json's packageManager pnpm@11.10.0 / engines.pnpm >= 11.0.0
Correctly wires no [services.*] block, but omits the explicit note that postgres/mysql are opt-in alternatives to the zero-config SQLite default
gcc/pkg-config installed without noting they are only needed for the opt-in CGO sqlite_mattn build (default is CGO_ENABLED=0)
Hook tests `[ pnpm-lock.yaml -nt node_modules ]` and `[ uv.lock -nt .venv ]` without existence guards; errors if either lockfile is absent
Extra packages (cairo, pixman, python314/uv, gnutar/gzip/zip) are plausible but unexplained relative to the repo's own flake.nix devShell

# Flox manifest version managed by Flox CLI
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

[install]
# Backend — go.mod requires 1.26.5; GOTOOLCHAIN=auto (below) fetches it.
go_1_26.pkg-path = "go_1_26"
gofumpt.pkg-path = "gofumpt"
sqlite.pkg-path = "sqlite"
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"

# Frontend — package.json engines.node >= 22.18.0
nodejs_26.pkg-path = "nodejs_26"
# Node 25+ no longer bundles corepack; install it standalone.
corepack.pkg-path = "corepack"
cairo.pkg-path = "cairo"
pixman.pkg-path = "pixman"
pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"

# Linting — pyproject.toml dev group (djlint, yamllint, zizmor) via uv
python314.pkg-path = "python314"
uv.pkg-path = "uv"

# Generic — Makefile and release tooling
git.pkg-path = "git"
git-lfs.pkg-path = "git-lfs"
gnumake.pkg-path = "gnumake"
gnused.pkg-path = "gnused"
gnutar.pkg-path = "gnutar"
gzip.pkg-path = "gzip"
zip.pkg-path = "zip"

[vars]
# The packaged Go defaults to GOTOOLCHAIN=local, which refuses go.mod's
# 1.26.5 requirement. Mirrors .devcontainer/devcontainer.json.
GOTOOLCHAIN = "auto"

[hook]
on-activate = '''
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export GOCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go/cache"
  export GOMODCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go/pkg/mod"
  mkdir -p "$GOPATH/bin" "$GOCACHE" "$GOMODCACHE"

  # package.json pins pnpm@11.10.0; corepack provisions that exact version
  # into a writable dir (the packaged node prefix is read-only).
  export COREPACK_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/corepack"
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin"
  corepack enable --install-directory "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin" pnpm >&2
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"

  # Mirrors `make deps-frontend` and `make deps-py`.
  if [ ! -d node_modules ] || [ pnpm-lock.yaml -nt node_modules ]; then
    pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >&2
  fi
  if [ ! -d .venv ] || [ uv.lock -nt .venv ]; then
    uv sync --frozen >&2
  fi
'''

[profile]
# `make deps-tools` installs air, golangci-lint, swagger, etc. to $GOPATH/bin.
bash = '''
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export PATH="$GOPATH/bin:$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"
'''
zsh = '''
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export PATH="$GOPATH/bin:$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"
'''
fish = '''
  set -x GOPATH "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  fish_add_path "$GOPATH/bin" "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin"
'''
